01 · THE ARTIST
✧

Naa manasane canvas meeda…

Nenoka Artist ni kaadu BujjiMyni…
Kaani naa manasane tellani Canvas meeda,
Nee roopanni ranguladdhuthu,
Ninnu naa gundello chitrinchukunna
Oka Painter laaga… 🎨❤️

A love that paints a whole universe.

02 · THE MUSICIAN
♫

Prathi swaram… nee pere.

Nenoka Musician ni kaadu BujjiMyni…
Kaani nenu vine prati paata,
Neeku vinipinchalani anipisthundi…
Endhukante aa paataloni prati padam,
Naa manasulo neetho maatladuthunnatte untundi… 🎶💕

A song my heart keeps singing.

03 · THE ENGINEER
♜ ✦

Prema ane kota…

Nenoka Civil Engineer ni kaadu BujjiMyni…
Kaani neekosam naa premanu punaadhiga vesukuni,
Mana prema ane oka kota kattukunna…
Kaalam maarina, paristhithulu maarina,
Eppatiki chediriponi kota adi…
Endhukante aa kota godalatho kaadhu BujjiMyni,
Naa nammakamtho, naa prematho kattindhi…
Aa kota nilabadedhi naa oopiri unnatha varaku kaadhu,
Naa chivari oopiri aagipoye varaku nee meedha unna prema thone… ❤️🫂

Built with trust, not walls.

04 · THE WRITER
📖

Mana kathaki chivari page undakoodadhu.

Nenoka Writer ni kaadu BujjiMyni…
Kaani neekosam oka pusthakam raayaalanundi…
Daanilo modati page mana parichayam,
Prati page mana prema,
Mana madhya jarige chinna chinna godavalu,
Aa godavala tharvaatha manam okarinokaram bujjaginchukune vidhaanam…
Prati page lo mana navvulu,
Prati aksharamlo mana anubandham,
Chivari page maatram eppatiki raakoodadhu…
Endhukante mana prema kathaki
Mugimpu anedhe undakoodadhu kadha BujjiMyni… 🥹❤️

A book we keep writing together.

05 · THE POET
✦

Ninnu thaluchukunte… kavithale.

Nenoka Poet ni kaadu BujjiMyni…

Naa manasuloni bhaavaalu kavithalavuthunnayi…
Ninnu choosthe padaalu saripovu,
Ninnu thaluchukunte maatalu saripovu,
Ninnu premisthunte ee okka janma saripademo anipisthundi… 💖

Some feelings are bigger than words.

◎ ♥

Nee navvu naa jnaapakam.

Nenoka Photographer ni kaadu BujjiMyni…

Nuvvu naa pakkana leni prathisaari,

Nuvvu navvuthunte choosthu undipovaalanundi,
Nuvvu maatladuthunte vintoo undipovaalanundi,

Endhukante nee santhoshamlo navvadame kaadhu,
Nee baadhallo kooda neeku thoduga undatame
Nijamaina prema ani nammevaadini nenu, BujjiMyni… ❤️🫂

To be there for your smiles and your hard days.

♡
